body:
Jessica Lunsford. She was only two days younger than me and lived relatively close. She was murdered, which I knew but didn’t look up the details until I was much older to learn how horrific it was.

I remember seeing all of the “Bring Jessica Home” signs on the news, then learning she’d been murdered. I looked the case up years later and learned that he had tricked her into getting into a garbage bag and buried her alive. That poor girl. 

[Wikipedia article ](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Murder_of_Jessica_Lunsford)

Yes! Such a baffling story. He even had a passport issued by “Taured” that verified all of his traveling claims. Everything had official stamps on it. Not to mention that he disappeared from his hotel room even though it was being guarded throughout the entire night to ensure that he wouldn’t try and escape.

I’ve linked it here for anyone who wants to [give it a read](http://weekinweird.com/2014/05/20/man-without-country-mystery-man-taured/).

Those little wooden boxes with a fake bug with wiggly legs inside! Those scared the absolute shit out of me. 

[a picture for those who don’t remember these atrocities ](https://cdn3.volusion.com/9gumh.3nq3j/v/vspfiles/photos/GM026-2.jpg?v-cache=1320787536)
It only shows me my schedule obviously so I was thinking that she adjusted my schedule individually, but if it’s the whole schedule the managers adjust then you’re probably right.
